utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: There’s still the fence and the loose step, if you can help with those. I’m free Saturday morning, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works for me. I can help with the fence and the step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the pickup time and what needs hauling first so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, fair enough — can you confirm the pickup time and what’s being hauled first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do that once I know the schedule—what time is pickup, and what’s the first load?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—sorry, I’ve been a bit scattered. I don’t have the latest yet, but I can check in and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d be great. Just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and tell people to come by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who needs help getting things fixed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and make sure they know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a bit late, but I heard there’s a repair drive going on—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane—could use a hand with tools, and maybe someone to sort them by job. If you’ve got a drill or a wrench set, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got a wrench set and I can sort the tools by job—point me to where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just let me know the time and where to drop things off, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I'll send you the time and drop-off spot as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks. I’ll watch for your message and plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are you still taking repair requests for the drive? I’ve got a lamp that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Mina — I’m still taking requests. Bring the lamp by and I’ll take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll bring it by later today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep track of who’s interested and where to send them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and see who wants to help out. Just let me know if you want me to send anyone your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—what still needs to be fixed first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with the leaky sink at Mrs. Alvarez’s and the broken front step at the community hall—they’re the most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Okay, I’ll put those first and see who can help with each one. I’ll check in with Mrs. Alvarez and the hall today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what we still need for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I haven’t kept a full list, but I know we’ve got some supplies already and still need a few more things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, just tell me the supplies we already have, and I’ll start a list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need anything, I can keep an eye out and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—especially if you spot any good screwdrivers or old extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Rey—I’ll keep an eye out for screwdrivers and extension cords and let you know if I spot any.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—before I help, can you tell me what kind of repair drive it is and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s a neighborhood repair drive for school-related fixes—mainly backpacks, lunch boxes, and a few small desk items. We’re just trying to get the broken stuff usable again before the week starts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—school items, mostly small fixes. If you have a list of what’s broken, I can help sort what can be repaired first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out with the repair drive. Just point me to what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — we could really use some extra hands and supplies. I’ll let you know what’s needed as soon as I get the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the repair drive to a few folks and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that’d be a huge help. Let me know if you need the details or I can pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll bring it up with a few neighbors and see who’s available. If you’ve got any details handy, send them my way and I’ll repeat them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I’ve heard a bit about it. What’s the plan for it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We're just trying to get a few things fixed up around the block, nothing fancy. If you can help spread the word, that'd mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. I’ll tell a few neighbors and see if anyone wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive—what do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly tools and a couple extra hands if folks are free—got a few fixes lined up already.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can swing by and lend a hand for a bit—what time do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m putting the repair drive details together now, and I’ll make sure the block gets a clear list of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — if you send me the list, I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and where everything should go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I’ll send it over shortly with the items, drop-off spot, and any priorities so you can organize it easily.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I need the exact drop-off time and what we’re collecting first. If we get the logistics sorted, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—I'll send the exact drop-off time and the first items to collect right away. Thanks for jumping in!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. Once you send those details, I’ll plan my route around them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm—this repair drive is really happening, right? And Hana’s the one organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s happening, but I want to double-check the details before I say more. I’m organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—thanks for confirming. Let me know once the details are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to know the plan before I commit. What time are we heading out for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m usually a little late, but I can make it by about 6:30. Does that work?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:30 works for me if we’re leaving soon after. Let’s keep it clear and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still collecting donations and figuring out what’s most needed first. I can check the supply list and let you know where we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be really helpful. I’m happy to pass it along if you find out what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we’re collecting broken items for the repair drive this Saturday morning by the community hall. If you can, just bring anything small that needs fixing and I’ll help sort it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll bring something small that needs fixing on Saturday morning by the community hall. Thanks for sorting it out, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school pickup, but I’ll need to leave before dinner. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 4:30. If you can make it by then, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 should work for me. I’ll come by right after pickup and head out before dinner.
